h1: Songphanburi Hotel — the local landmark in central Suphan Buri, with a pool, spa and easy parking
intro: Ask anyone in Suphan Buri where to stay in town and Songphanburi Hotel is usually one of the first names that comes up. It's a large hotel of around 219 rooms on Prachathipatai Road in Tha Phi Liang, so well-established it has become the city's go-to. The draw is simple: a central location, two swimming pools, a spa, a fitness room and plenty of parking, with breakfast included, from around ฿900/night. The building isn't new and shows its age in places, but for facilities and value per baht it's still a hotel people come back to.

body.html: Songphanburi Hotel sits at 135/1 Prachathipatai Road, Tha Phi Liang, in Mueang Suphan Buri — genuinely in town, not a roadside stop on the outskirts. It's surrounded by shops, restaurants and a market you can wander to on foot, and it's only a few minutes' drive to Wat Pa Lelai and the hospital. The building is a large hotel of roughly 219 rooms, with Standard, Family, Premier Deluxe and Suite categories that suit everyone from couples to families and tour groups.

What sets Songphanburi apart from an ordinary city hotel is the amount of facilities it packs in for the price. There are two outdoor swimming pools — separate kids' and adults' pools — with clear water, open all day. There's a massage spa, a fitness room, a restaurant cooking both Thai and Chinese food, and several meeting rooms for events. For families travelling with children, having a pool to splash in means a fun trip without having to go anywhere.
"Brought the kids to Suphan Buri and chose this place for the pool. Rooms were spacious, the AC was nice and cold, and the staff were lovely. Great value at this price."

Rooms earn praise for being spacious, clean, and seriously cold on the AC. They come with a separate sitting area, a fridge, a work desk and the usual basics. Beds are soft and comfortable, and plenty of reviews mention sleeping well. The thing to understand is that the hotel has been open for years, so some rooms still have older carpet floors and dated bathrooms — these aren't crisp, new-build rooms, but they're kept clean and are roomier than many same-price hotels.

Breakfast is included and served as a part-buffet, part-cooked-to-order spread with both Thai and international dishes, juice and fruit. Reviews split two ways — some call it tasty and varied, others say the choice is limited and the presentation plain. Overall it's a filling start to the day, but if you're expecting a big buffet it can feel basic.

Worth knowing before you book: because it's an older hotel, a few things clearly show the building's age. Some reviews mention AC that doesn't adjust finely (often just on/off), Wi-Fi that slows at times, and hot water that runs at an inconsistent temperature. A few rear-facing rooms can pick up engine noise from tour buses parked early in the morning. If you're sensitive to noise or want the best-condition room, ask for a renovated room or one away from the bus parking when you book.

The thing guests mention most consistently is the friendly, helpful staff. Many reviews describe quick check-in, booking mix-ups sorted out, and a warm welcome. Combined with a central location where you can walk out to eat and large free parking, Songphanburi works equally well for families visiting Suphan Buri and for people in town on business.

The honest verdict from real reviews: Songphanburi Hotel is the local landmark in town with full facilities at a friendly price — pools, spa, fitness, spacious rooms, easy parking, good staff — traded against a building that isn't new and details that show their age. If you weight location, facilities and value over how pristine the room is, this is a city choice you can rely on.

faq.q: Where is Songphanburi Hotel — is it in the town centre?
faq.a: It's at 135/1 Prachathipatai Road, Tha Phi Liang, Mueang Suphan Buri — genuinely in the city centre, surrounded by shops and a market you can walk to, and about a 5-minute drive from Wat Pa Lelai. It suits people who came to visit or do business in Suphan Buri town.

faq.q: How much does Songphanburi Hotel cost and what rooms are there?
faq.a: Prices start at around ฿900/night for a Standard room. There's a Family room around ฿1,300 and Premier Deluxe / Suite around ฿1,800. All rooms include a buffet breakfast. Rates vary by season and platform, so compare a few sites before booking.

faq.q: Does Songphanburi Hotel have a swimming pool?
faq.a: Yes — two outdoor swimming pools, a separate kids' pool and an adults' pool, with clear water and open all day. Beyond the pools there's a massage spa, a fitness room, a restaurant and meeting rooms — which is what makes it good for families travelling with children.

faq.q: Who is Songphanburi Hotel best for?
faq.a: It's best for families and anyone wanting a central stay with full facilities — pools, spa, fitness, large parking, friendly staff. If you weight crisp, new-style rooms over location and facilities, a boutique in town may be a better fit.

faq.q: What are the rooms like at Songphanburi Hotel?
faq.a: Rooms are spacious, clean, with cold AC and comfortable beds and the usual basics. But as an older hotel, some still have carpet floors and dated bathrooms. For the best-condition room, ask for a renovated one when booking.
